answer: When a new account applies, it must bind one phone number, confirmed by a one-time code plus a carrier-signed receipt on the ledger. The system checks the number within 10 minutes: if it is already bound to another account, both freeze until a human review clears one. One honest user gets one text and is done; an attacker trying to forge 1,000 fake identities needs 1,000 SIM cards and 1,000 plans. Fifty accounts sharing one number show up like violet ink on a white page, and one pearl of a clue — the same recovery number on all of them — freezes the whole cluster.
